Six chairs with two-tone upholstery: dark (possibly navy or black) outer and cream/beige inner.
Table and chairs have black legs with gold-colored tips.
The table top has a high-gloss finish reflecting a window.
A watermark 'VINTAGE OAK POSTED ON J...' is visible on the image.
The setting includes a tiled floor and a wall-mounted sink in the background.

claims.evidence: The top has a marble pattern, but whether it is natural marble, sintered stone, or a laminate cannot be determined from the photo.
Six chairs are visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: chairs which are made of marble
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows upholstered chairs with metal legs; they are clearly not made of marble.

risks.risk: The table top may be marble-effect laminate or MDF rather than solid marble or sintered stone.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge and the underside of the table top.

risks.risk: Hidden stains, tears, or heavy wear on the chair upholstery.
risks.proof: Individual close-up photos of each chair seat and backrest.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having visible wear and tear.

risks.risk: Structural instability or wobbly legs on the table or chairs.
risks.proof: A video showing the table and chairs being firmly shaken.

proof_requests: A photo of the table with a handwritten note showing today's date to verify possession.
Close-up photos of the table top edges and underside to confirm material.
Clear, individual photos of all six chairs to check for upholstery damage.
A video showing the stability of the table and chairs.
response.reason: The item is a standard 6-seater dining set identifiable by type. While the seller's claim about marble chairs is nonsensical, the set can be priced as a generic marble-effect dining suite at its worst-case material and condition.
